title: Detailed pretzel
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow/glow under pretzel -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='32' ry='5' fill='#3a2a10' opacity='0.4'/>

  <!-- main pretzel body - outer thick loop -->
  <!-- left loop -->
  <path d='M50 20 
           C30 20, 12 35, 12 55 
           C12 72, 28 82, 42 76 
           C50 73, 50 62, 44 58 
           C38 54, 30 58, 32 66 
           C34 72, 42 72, 48 68'
        fill='none' stroke='#c07820' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- right loop -->
  <path d='M50 20 
           C70 20, 88 35, 88 55 
           C88 72, 72 82, 58 76 
           C50 73, 50 62, 56 58 
           C62 54, 70 58, 68 66 
           C66 72, 58 72, 52 68'
        fill='none' stroke='#c07820' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- center twist/cross -->
  <path d='M38 40 C44 50, 56 50, 62 40' 
        fill='none' stroke='#c07820' stroke-width='11' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- lighter inner highlight on left loop -->
  <path d='M50 26 
           C34 26, 20 38, 20 54 
           C20 66, 32 74, 42 70'
        fill='none' stroke='#e09a3a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- lighter inner highlight on right loop -->
  <path d='M50 26 
           C66 26, 80 38, 80 54 
           C80 66, 68 74, 58 70'
        fill='none' stroke='#e09a3a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- center highlight -->
  <path d='M42 42 C46 49, 54 49, 58 42' 
        fill='none' stroke='#e09a3a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- darker edges for depth on left -->
  <path d='M50 20 
           C30 20, 12 35, 12 55'
        fill='none' stroke='#a05c10' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M12 55 
           C12 72, 28 82, 42 76'
        fill='none' stroke='#a05c10' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- darker edges right -->
  <path d='M50 20 
           C70 20, 88 35, 88 55'
        fill='none' stroke='#a05c10' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>
  <path d='M88 55 
           C88 72, 72 82, 58 76'
        fill='none' stroke='#a05c10' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- salt crystals -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='62' r='1.8' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='32' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='24' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='24' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='32' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='50' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='64' r='1.7' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='74' r='1.4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
